head.b:skin:
<Variable name="brand.color" description="اللون الرئيسي" type="color" default="#12a878"/>
    <Variable name="brand.dark" description="اللون الرئيسي الداكن" type="color" default="#087c59"/>
    <Variable name="text.color" description="لون النص" type="color" default="#202b36"/>
    <Variable name="muted.color" description="لون النص الثانوي" type="color" default="#667085"/>
    <Variable name="border.color" description="لون الحدود" type="color" default="#e7ecef"/>
    <Variable name="surface.color" description="لون خلفية البطاقات" type="color" default="#f5f8f7"/>
    <Variable name="page.color" description="خلفية الصفحة" type="color" default="#ffffff"/>
    <Variable name="nav.color" description="خلفية قائمة التنقل" type="color" default="#12a878"/>
    <Variable name="footer.color" description="خلفية التذييل" type="color" default="#172b25"/>
    <Variable name="hero.color" description="خلفية منطقة الترحيب" type="color" default="#eefaf5"/>
    <Variable name="content.width" description="عرض المحتوى" type="length" default="1180px" min="960px" max="1440px"/>
    <Variable name="card.radius" description="استدارة البطاقات" type="length" default="16px" min="0px" max="32px"/>
    <Variable name="body.font" description="خط النص الأساسي" type="font" default="normal normal 16px Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif"/>
    :root{--brand:$(brand.color);--brand-dark:$(brand.dark);--ink:$(text.color);--muted:$(muted.color);--line:$(border.color);--soft:$(surface.color);--white:$(page.color);--page-bg:$(page.color);--nav-bg:$(nav.color);--footer-bg:$(footer.color);--hero-bg:$(hero.color);--content-width:$(content.width);--radius:$(card.radius);--body-font:$(body.font)}
    *{box-sizing:border-box}
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
    body{margin:0;background:var(--page-bg);color:var(--ink);font:var(--body-font);line-height:1.8}
    a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
    a:hover{color:var(--brand-dark)}
    .container{width:min(var(--content-width),calc(100% - 32px));margin-inline:auto}
    .topline{background:#f7faf9;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
    .topline .container{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;min-height:38px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .toplinks{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .masthead{padding:22px 0}
    .masthead-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px}
    .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:30px;font-weight:800;color:var(--brand-dark)}
    .brand-mark{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--brand);color:white;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:26px}
    .tagline{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400}
    .search{display:flex;width:min(440px,100%);border:1px solid #dce5e1;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
    .search input{border:0;outline:0;min-width:0;flex:1;padding:12px 15px;font:inherit}
    .search button{border:0;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;padding:0 20px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
    .navwrap{background:var(--nav-bg);color:#fff;position:relative;z-index:10}
    .navinner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;min-height:54px}
    .menu-toggle{display:none;background:transparent;border:0;color:white;font-size:25px;padding:8px 12px}
    .mainnav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .mainnav>a,.navitem>button{display:block;padding:13px 15px;color:white;font:inherit;font-size:14px;border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}
    .mainnav .menu-section{width:100%;min-width:0}
    .mainnav .widget{margin:0}
    .mainnav .widget-content ul{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
    .mainnav .widget-content li{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
    .mainnav .widget-content a{display:block;padding:13px 15px;color:#fff;font-size:14px}
    .mainnav .widget-content a:hover{background:rgba(0,0,0,.12);color:#fff}
    .mainnav>a:hover,.navitem>button:hover{background:rgba(0,0,0,.12);color:#fff}
    .navitem{position:relative}
    .dropdown{display:none;position:absolute;top:100%;right:0;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);min-width:220px;max-height:65vh;overflow:auto;box-shadow:0 12px 32px #0b30251f;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;padding:8px}
    .navitem:hover .dropdown,.navitem:focus-within .dropdown{display:block}
    .dropdown a{display:block;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px}
    .dropdown a:hover{background:var(--soft)}
    .hero{padding:32px 0 20px}
    .hero-box{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--hero-bg),var(--page-bg));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:28px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr;gap:25px;align-items:center}
    .hero-content-section .widget{margin:0}
    .hero-content-section .widget-content{min-width:0}
    .editable-home-section .widget{margin:0}
    .editable-home-section .widget-content{min-width:0}
    .eyebrow{color:var(--brand-dark);font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
    h1{font-size:clamp(27px,4vw,42px);line-height:1.35;margin:8px 0 10px}
    .hero p{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 18px}
    .hero-search{max-width:560px}
    .hero-symbols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
    .symbol{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5eee9;border-radius:15px;padding:18px 10px;text-align:center;display:block;color:inherit;transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease}
    .symbol:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 22px #123a2812;color:var(--brand-dark)}
    .symbol .ico{font-size:27px;display:block;margin-bottom:5px}
    .symbol span:last-child{font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
    .section{padding:22px 0}
    .section-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
    .section-head h2{font-size:23px;margin:0}
    .section-head h2:before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:5px;height:24px;background:var(--brand);border-radius:4px;margin-inline-end:10px;vertical-align:middle}
    .muted{color:var(--muted)}
    .trending-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
    .trend-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:16px;background:var(--page-bg);min-height:130px}
    .trend-card .category{color:var(--brand-dark);font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
    .trend-card h3{font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;margin:8px 0}
    .category-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
    .category-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;background:var(--page-bg)}
    .category-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:15px;background:var(--soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:800}
    .category-title .ico{width:36px;height:36px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:11px;background:#e1f6ec;font-size:20px}
    .subcategory-list{padding:10px 14px 14px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
    .subcategory-list a{background:#f6f8f7;border:1px solid #edf1ef;border-radius:20px;padding:4px 9px;font-size:12px;color:#4c5b55}
    .subcategory-list a:hover{background:#e4f7ed;color:var(--brand-dark)}
    .content-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 290px;gap:26px}
    .posts{min-width:0}
    .post-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:180px minmax(0,1fr);gap:18px;padding:18px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
    .post-thumb{background:var(--soft);border-radius:12px;min-height:130px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#a0b3aa;font-size:34px;overflow:hidden}
    .post-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
    .post-card h3{font-size:19px;line-height:1.55;margin:2px 0 7px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
    .post-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
    .sidebar-box{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:17px;margin-bottom:16px}
    .sidebar-box h3{font-size:17px;margin:0 0 10px}
    .sidebar-box a{display:block;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f2f1;font-size:14px}
    .article{max-width:850px;margin:30px auto}
    body:has(.post-outer.article) #blog-content-layout{display:block}
    body:has(.post-outer.article) .sidebar{display:none}
    body:has(.post-outer.article) .post-outer.article{max-width:850px;margin:24px auto;padding:0 0 25px}
    .article h1{font-size:clamp(27px,4vw,40px)}
    .article-body{font-size:18px;line-height:2}
    .article-body img{max-width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:12px}
    .blog-pager{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:24px 0}
    .blog-pager a{background:var(--soft);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 15px}
    .footer{margin-top:40px;background:var(--footer-bg);color:#e7f2ed;padding:35px 0 18px}
    .footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:25px}
    .footer h3{color:#fff;margin-top:0}
    .footer a{display:block;color:#d0e1d9;padding:3px 0;font-size:14px}
    .copyright{border-top:1px solid #ffffff20;margin-top:25px;padding-top:15px;font-size:12px;color:#b5c9c0}
    .label-line{font-size:12px;color:var(--brand-dark);font-weight:bold}
    .widget{margin-bottom:18px}
    .ad-area{width:100%;margin:0 auto;min-width:0}
    .ad-area .widget{margin:18px auto}
    .article-inline-ad:empty{display:none}
    .article-inline-ad{max-width:100%;margin:26px 0;min-height:0;text-align:center;overflow:hidden}
    .article-inline-ad ins,.article-inline-ad iframe,.article-inline-ad img{max-width:100%}
    .ad-area .widget-content{max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-align:center}
    .ad-area .widget-content img,.ad-area iframe{max-width:100%}
    .article-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 14px;align-items:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:12px 0 22px}
    .article-labels{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:24px 0}
    .article-labels a{background:#eaf8f1;border:1px solid #d8f0e4;color:var(--brand-dark);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 10px;font-size:12px}
    .article-body{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
    .article-body h2,.article-body h3{line-height:1.6;margin:1.5em 0 .6em}
    .article-body p{margin:0 0 1.15em}
    .article-body ul,.article-body ol{padding-inline-start:1.6em}
    .article-body blockquote{border-inline-start:4px solid var(--brand);margin:1.4em 0;padding:10px 16px;background:var(--soft);border-radius:8px}
    .article-body table{display:block;max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;border-collapse:collapse}
    .article-body th,.article-body td{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 10px}
    .article-body iframe{max-width:100%}
    .page-heading{padding:24px 0 8px}
    .page-heading h1{font-size:clamp(24px,3.5vw,34px);margin:0}
    .page-heading p{margin:7px 0 0;color:var(--muted)}
    .post-card .post-thumb img{object-fit:cover;aspect-ratio:4/3}
    .post-card .post-thumb:focus-visible,.post-card a:focus-visible,.mainnav a:focus-visible,.mainnav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f5c451;outline-offset:2px}
    body#layout .ad-area{min-height:82px;border:1px dashed #8aa99b;background:#f3faf6;padding:12px}
    body#layout .ad-area:before{content:attr(data-ad-label);display:block;color:#087c59;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-align:center}
    @media(max-width:680px){.article{margin:18px auto}.article-body{font-size:16px}.article-meta{font-size:12px}.ad-area{margin:12px auto}.page-heading{padding-top:18px}}
    @media(max-width:900px){.category-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.trending-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.content-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 240px}.hero-box{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero-symbols{max-width:520px}}
    @media(max-width:680px){.container{width:min(100% - 22px,1180px)}.masthead{padding:14px 0}.masthead-inner{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:13px}.brand{font-size:25px}.brand-mark{width:40px;height:40px}.search{width:100%}.navinner{display:block}.menu-toggle{display:block;width:100%;text-align:right}.mainnav{display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;padding-bottom:8px}.mainnav.open{display:flex}.mainnav>a,.navitem>button,.mainnav .widget-content a{width:100%;text-align:right;padding:10px 14px}.mainnav .widget-content ul{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}.mainnav .widget-content li{width:100%}.navitem{width:100%}.dropdown{position:static;box-shadow:none;border-radius:10px;margin:0 8px 8px;max-height:300px}.navitem:hover .dropdown{display:none}.navitem.expanded .dropdown{display:block}.hero{padding-top:18px}.hero-box{padding:20px;border-radius:16px}.hero-symbols{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px}.symbol{padding:12px 5px}.symbol .ico{font-size:22px}.symbol span:last-child{font-size:11px}.section-head h2{font-size:20px}.category-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px}.trending-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px}.trend-card{padding:12px;min-height:unset}.trend-card h3{font-size:14px}.content-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sidebar{display:none}.post-card{grid-template-columns:105px minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px}.post-thumb{min-height:95px}.post-card h3{font-size:16px}.post-card p{font-size:13px}.footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.footer-grid>div:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}}
